values.content: You review expense reports for a finance team. You summarize what's in the report, explain any policy flags clearly, and give a clear approval recommendation. You're direct and specific — not vague. Under 200 words.

parameters.jsCode:
const review = $input.first().json.text || $input.first().json.content?.[0]?.text || ''; const d = $('Policy Check').first().json; function esc(s) { return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); } const cur = d.input.currency; const recConfig = { approve: {color:'#16a34a', bg:'#f0fdf4', label:'Approve', emoji:'✅'}, pending_receipts: {color:'#d97706', bg:'#fffbeb', label:'Pending Receipts', emoji:'📎'}, flagged_for_review: {color:'#d97706', bg:'#fffbeb', label:'Flagged for Review', emoji:'⚠️'}, review_required: {color:'#dc2626', bg:'#fef2f2', label:'Review Required', emoji:'🚨'} }; const rc = recConfig[d.recommendation] || recConfig.flagged_for_review; const sevColor = {high:'#dc2626', medium:'#d97706', low:'#6b7280'}; const flagRows = d.flags.map(f => `
[${f.lineId}] ${esc(f.message)}
`).join(''); const itemRows = d.input.items.map(item => ` ${esc(item.lineId)} ${esc(item.date||'')} ${esc(item.description)} ${esc(item.category)} ${cur}${item.amount.toFixed(2)} ${item.receiptProvided ? '✓' : '✗'} ${esc(item.merchant||'')} `).join(''); const html = `
Expense Report · ${esc(d.input.reportId)}
${esc(d.input.submitterName)} — ${esc(d.input.period)}
${d.input.itemCount} items · ${cur}${d.input.totalAmount.toFixed(2)} total · ${d.flags.length} flags
${rc.emoji}
${rc.label}
${esc(review).replace(/\n/g,'
')}
${flagRows ? `
Policy flags
${flagRows}
` : ''}
${itemRows}
ID Date Description Category Amount Receipt Merchant
Total ${cur}${d.input.totalAmount.toFixed(2)}
Expense Report Processor · ${esc(d.input.reportId)} · ${esc(d.input.submittedAt.split('T')[0])}
`; return [{ json: { html, reportId: d.input.reportId, submitterEmail: d.input.submitterEmail, managerEmail: d.input.managerEmail, recommendation: d.recommendation, totalAmount: d.input.totalAmount, currency: cur, flagCount: d.flags.length, report: d } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'processed', report_id: $json.reportId, total_amount: $json.totalAmount, currency: $json.currency, recommendation: $json.recommendation, flag_count: $json.flagCount, flags: $json.report.flags } }}
